newsitem.title: USA: Boyd Gaming sees Q4 revs, EBITDA higher.
newsitem.headline: Boyd Gaming sees Q4 revs, EBITDA higher.

text.p: Boyd Gaming Corp expects revenues and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) for the fourth quarter to be higher than in the third quarter and than its 1996 fourth quarter pro forma results.
The forecast fourth quarter results would include the acquisition of Par-A-Dice Hotel and Casino.
Despite these recent trends, the company expects that pro forma revenues and EBITDA for fiscal year 1997 will be lower than for fiscal 1996.
